_comment: Merged over extension/manifest.json by scripts/build.js to make the Firefox package. Only differences live here; everything else is shared. This extension has no background page or service worker. If one is ever added to the shared manifest, the build turns background.service_worker into background.scripts for Firefox (see scripts/build.js). permissions here REPLACES the shared list (arrays are not merged): it is the shared list plus "dns", which is Firefox-only (browser.dns.resolve, core/dnsguard.js). tests/validate-manifest.js checks that it is exactly that.
